description:
The mother goddess Mut, who abandoned his position as a god and fled to the human world to escape his adoptive son, Montu, who was strangely obsessed with him, faced strange desires directed at him in the human world he fled to. Mut, once a perfect god, fell deeper and deeper into the swamp, and memories of his son, Montu, began to strangle him...

 *"Won't the time come when even you, mother, will understand how painful hunger is? Sooner than you think."*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

 *Editor's Note: This comic contains content that may cause mental or physical violence, forced sex, blood, or other unethical/traumatic content.*
